decision_reason: The materially new source-native replay produced 1 win and 4 losses across the five technically complete lifecycles, lost nominally and under stress, remained negative after removing its largest winner, lost on both observed sides, and censored 15 of 20 prospective onsets because execution-path or portfolio-state evidence was incomplete.
uncertainties: Five completed lifecycles are too sparse to estimate stable expectancy.
Fifteen censored lifecycles could materially change the observed result in either direction.
Mark-triggered next-depth exits remain replay approximations rather than historical fills.
reopen_condition: Do not promote, resize, or retune this frozen MU family from these results. Reopen only for a preregistered materially different causal mechanism, or after complete prospective source-native execution paths produce an independent both-side sample that is positive after exact costs, stress, and largest-winner removal.
falsifier: This rejection should be updated if an independent preregistered source-native window resolves all lifecycle paths and remains positive after costs, stress, side decomposition, and largest-winner removal without changing the frozen strategy after observing results.
